column1: Think of Marty. Please tell us whether you agree with the sentences below. Answer based on how you feel right now. Rating scale: 0 = "no", 1 = "maybe", 2 =" yes"
column2: Denk an Marty. Bitte sag uns, ob du den folgenden Aussagen zustimmst. Beantworte die Fragen so, wie du dich gerade fühlst. Bewertungsskala: 0 = „nein“, 1 = „vielleicht“, 2 = „ja“
